title: Steamgear Mash
native_title: スチームギア★マッシュ
overview:
An iron body and a hot heart!! The first multi-genre game in history makes its debut!!!

Here comes a greedy game packed with the best parts of all kinds of games: action, shooting, mazes and more!!

Mash is a steam-powered living machine who lives happily in Term World with his creator, Dr. Sendagaya, and the doctor's granddaughter Mina. When the evil emperor Gash and his army conquer the land and carry Mina off, Mash sets out to rescue her.

At its core this is an action shooter viewed from an isometric angle. Blast enemies, hold the button for a charged shot, and jump between platforms as you explore maze-like stages. Collect special weapons such as bombs, fire shots and a 5-way spread, and use them to break through blocks and doors that bar your way. Lock your facing to strafe, or stand still and spin to fire in any direction. Stages also switch to scrolling aerial shooting and swimming sections, and a boss waits at the end of each one.

- Power up with items found along the way
- Save after clearing a stage or at save points

鉄のからだと熱い心!! 史上初のマルチジャンルゲーム新登場!!!

アクション、シューティング、迷路、などなどいろんなゲームの面白いところをつめこんだ欲張りゲームの登場だ!!
